Bedi is a new recruit of the Cult of the Absolute who can be encountered in Act Two. He is initially found in the outskirts of the Ruined Battlefield, on a mission to escort a True Soul to Moonrise Towers.
“
Don't wander into the dark. It's hungry.
„
— Bedi

Involvement

Act Two

Follow the Convoy

If the party reach the Shadow-Cursed Lands through the Mountain Pass, Bedi is a short jog away from the entry point, on the edge of the Shadow Curse and on the lookout for potential threats. His small group of Absolutists is led by fellow half-orc  Kansif, and he is joined by the goblins  Brawler Vez,  Warrior Gronag, and  Sharp-Eye Lora.

Speaking with Kansif gives the party the opportunity to initiate ⁠Follow the Convoy by playing the  Spider's Lyre, which summons  Kar'niss. The party can attack Bedi and the cultists or follow the convoy to Moonrise Towers.

Ambush

Following the cultists takes them and the party through the Ruined Battlefield, where a nearby group of Harpers lay in wait to ambush the convoy in an attempt to acquire Kar'niss'  Moonlantern. The Harpers immediately attack the convoy on sight, but momentarily give the party a chance to change sides and attack Kansif and the other cultists, which advances ⁠Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse. Otherwise, siding with the Absolutists allows the party to ⁠Infiltrate Moonrise Towers, while siding with the Harpers leads to Bedi's death and has  Branthos refer the party to Last Light Inn.

Alternatively, if the party reach the Shadow-Cursed Lands through Grymforge, the party encounter Bedi and the convoy for the first time mid-transit, with or without a Harper escort. The party can either ambush the convoy and seize the  Moonlantern, let them pass, or convince Kar'niss to give them the Moonlantern. If they wait a little longer before attacking, Kar'niss slays Lora for venturing towards where the party and Harpers are hiding.

Convincing the cultists to part with the Moonlantern results in them walking into the Shadow Curse, only to be found later in the center of Reithwin as  Shadow-Cursed Undead. They are automatically hostile to the party in this form and can only be fought.

Arriving at Moonrise Towers

If the party side with Bedi and he survives, Bedi arrives alongside the party at Moonrise, where Kar'niss departs. Bedi remains in the towers' quarters, alongside Kansif and the goblins. Talking with Bedi has him disdainfully ridicule the state of Moonrise Towers, unimpressed and seeing it unfit for the Absolute.[1] Although, he shows rabid eagerness in invading Baldur's Gate in Her name.[2]

Bedi tends to voice his thoughts out loud, making disrespectful remarks towards  General Thorm, to which Kansif berates him and tells him to guard his tongue.[3]
